CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Did the CM confirm what the complaint was about and clearly identify the issues?
Did CM approach conversation with an open mind to understand customers issues & position? Did CM summarise the issues back to the customer & ask if there is anything else? Did they give clear next steps? E.g ‘Can I confirm the issues you are wanting us to resolve?’ ‘I can see in your complaint you are wanting us to resolve X. Have I got this right?’ Did CM recognise vulnerability triggers & act appropriately?
CustomField.label: CM confirmed complaint, identified issue
